commands.rocprof: ROCTX_LIB="$(uv run python -c 'from scripts.roctx_discovery import default_sdk; print(default_sdk(profiler_first=True))')" HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/qwen38-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --marker-trace --hip-runtime-trace --memory-copy-trace --output-format csv -d /tmp/qwen38-verifier-width-trace -o run -- .venv/bin/python scripts/qwen38_verifier_width_profile.py --contexts 64,2048 --repetitions 4 --warmups 2 --output /tmp/qwen38-verifier-width-profiled.json

findings: Additional rows are not free: width cost increases in warm graph replay with no capture. Equal DSpine throughput at 6/8 rows mixed verifier time and acceptance, so it did not establish a bandwidth floor.
Q4 gate/up and Q6 projection kernels dominate short-context device time, but other Q4/Q5 projections and recurrent operations also grow with width. This is not a single marginal-row bottleneck.

At context 2048, the exact scalar split-K attention producer is repeated per row and is the largest width-8 kernel family. It adds a context-dependent component absent from the short-context estimate.
Width one is eager; graph widths 2..8 remove host submission cost. The one-to-two difference is not a clean arithmetic slope.

The public production owner selects target_verifier_production_q4_rowtile=true with FP32 recurrent state. This differs from constructing an unbound low-level session and must be held constant in the matched comparison.

No kernel arithmetic changed. Preserve strict/public defaults; proceed with matched public comparison before allocating a separate attention or projection redesign. The requested profiling step does not by itself justify a new default.

historical_reconciliation.caveat: Inferred only from aggregate throughput and mean acceptance, assuming tokens/cycle=1+budget*acceptance; short-output truncation and aggregation prevent treating it as a measured verifier latency.

limitations: zbook/Radeon 8060S thermally variable diagnostic, not the stable-clock desktop lane; absolute times cannot transfer to another host.
Repeated synthetic prefixes exercise widths, not task quality or full category acceptance. Public ranking is separate.
Profiled wall and unprofiled wall are separate runs; kernel attribution is not a subtraction from unprofiled times.
Initial invalid snapshot attempt retained locally only; a targeted CPU regression protects the corrected live-destination/backup contract.
Unprofiled run predates addition of the completed artifact field only; its exit status, complete row matrix and all exact checks passed.
